name: Gonzalo Jorcastle
source: Gonzalo is the second son of the Jorcastle family, and a popular guy in the Finsel social circles. At the request of his family, he studied to become a mage, but his interest in battle is almost nonexistent. Despite this, he is often seen fighting along side with Finsel's guardsmen. Perhaps there is someone in the guardsmen he wishes to protect?
